short: Offering a larger or premium version of what is being bought.
metaDescription: Upselling offers a larger, better or premium version of what a customer is already buying — a bigger size, a premium ingredient, an extended warranty.
definition: Upselling offers a larger, better or premium version of what a customer is already buying — a bigger size, a premium ingredient, an extended warranty. It raises order value on a decision already made.
bodyHtml:
Why Upselling matters

The customer has already chosen to buy, so the incremental cost of the offer is a sentence. Upsells typically carry higher margins than the base item, which is why they move profit faster than revenue.

Upselling formula

Attach rate % = Orders containing the upsell ÷ Total orders × 100

Multiply by the upsell's contribution to value the opportunity.

How Upselling works in practice

Script it as a specific suggestion rather than a question — naming an item works, asking if they want anything else does not. Train it into the ordering flow and measure attach rate by staff member.

faq.question: What is the difference between upselling and cross-selling?
faq.answer: Upselling improves the item being bought; cross-selling adds a different item alongside it.

faq.question: Does upselling annoy customers?
faq.answer: Only when it is generic. A relevant, specific suggestion usually reads as helpful.
